data.one_liner: Mathematical functions for numerical computations in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides trigonometry, gamma, beta, error functions, polynomial evaluation, factorial, and other numerical utilities. It supports null safety and depends only on the tuple package.
use_when: Need mathematical functions for scientific or engineering calculations
Require gamma, beta, or error functions
Need polynomial evaluation or factorials in Dart code
avoid_when: Performance or high‑precision requirements beyond the provided functions
weaknesses: No advanced linear algebra or matrix operations
Limited documentation on performance and edge cases
